# Wrecked Metal v0.1.3 — Quieter announcer, custom music

A sound and polish release.

> **You need your own ROM.** This release contains no ROM and no game assets, exactly like the earlier betas.

## New

- **Announcer voices off.** All the narrated lines are now muted in Wrecked Metal: the title welcome, checkpoints, the "bonus" calls on big hits, and the rest. Sound effects and music are unchanged. Turn them back on in the R menu > audio > "announcer voice". **Play Fidelity** keeps the voices, as on the N64.
- **Separate custom music for the title and the menus.** Put your own tracks in `Data/Music` as `pressStart` (title / Press Start) and `menuSelect` (menus and car select), in `.ogg`, `.mp3` or `.mpeg`. Play Fidelity always uses the original music.
- **Music credit on the title screen:** "Music By Domgalegone".
- **Throttle and brake bars (T/B) on the HUD**, plus smoke and dust that react to the ground under each wheel.

## Install

Download the APK below and install it over the previous version: your settings, save and ROM are kept.

**Requirements:** Android 10+, Vulkan, and a device that can run 32-bit apps (this build is `armeabi-v7a`).

## Support

Wrecked Metal is free and will stay free. If you'd like to support the work, tips are welcome on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/costelinha_games). Entirely voluntary, and nothing is locked behind them.

— Costelinha Games
